title: A federated learning algorithm for non-independent and identically distributed data
assignee: Huaneng Yimin Coal and Electricity Co Ltd

pse.problem: Data heterogeneity problem in federated learning scenarios due to non-identical and non-independent (non-IID) distribution of data among participating devices
pse.solution_function: Balances the non-IID problem by calculating the distance between the global model and local model, using a slice random selection strategy for participant selection and a calculation tilt strategy to optimize aggregation model by training participants closer to the global model in more rounds
pse.solution_structure: Includes federated learning system architecture with a global model, local models at each participating device, and communication channels for data exchange
pse.solution_implementation: The algorithm uses slice random selection strategy to select participants and calculation tilt strategy to adjust training rounds based on the distance between global model and local model. It also includes data exchange protocols for transmitting model updates during aggregation process
pse.effect: Improves model accuracy, reduces communication overhead, and speeds up model convergence by addressing non-IID problem in federated learning scenarios
